name: What factors should I consider when choosing a stucco texture?

mainEntity.name: What factors should I consider when choosing a stucco texture?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a stucco texture, consider your home's architectural style, your desired aesthetic, and the texture's durability. A smooth finish suits modern homes, while a dash or Santa Barbara texture complements Mediterranean or traditional designs. Think about how the texture will look with your home's existing features, like windows and trim. Also, consider maintenance; some textures may be harder to clean or repair than others. Viewing samples in different lighting conditions can help visualize the final outcome.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider your home's architectural style, desired aesthetic, and the texture's durability and maintenance when choosing a stucco texture.
